title: Sunrise Rhythm
style: English, afrobeats, warm male tenor, bright and relaxed, log drums, marimba and clean guitar, sunlit joyful, crisp modern production, 104 BPM
lyrics:
[Intro]
Danfo horn, danfo horn
Sun coming up on the bridge now

[Verse 1]
Morning market, five a.m., the tomatoes still cold
Aunty Chidi counting naira with her glasses on her head
I buy two oranges, she throws in a third for luck
Say I'm looking skinny, say I need to eat
Bus conductor hanging from the door
Calling Yaba, calling Yaba, enter with your change
Somebody's radio playing from a kiosk
Whole street moving like it already knows the song

[Pre-Chorus]
And the sun comes up slow over the roofs
Like it's got nowhere to be
And my heart does that thing it does
When the day's still a maybe

[Chorus]
Sunrise rhythm, keep it easy, keep it light
Sunrise rhythm, we got time, we got time
Every corner's got a sound, every sound is coming clear
Sunrise rhythm, let the morning find us here

[Verse 2]
You said meet me by the yellow kiosk, no hurry
I came early anyway, bought groundnut in a paper cone
You came running with one shoe half off
Said the tricycle dropped you on the wrong side of town
We laughed till the seller asked what was so funny
You said nothing, paid for mangoes, gave me the first one
Traffic building up behind us like a choir
And the pothole water catching all that gold

[Pre-Chorus]
And the sun comes up slow over the roofs
Like it's got nowhere to be
And my heart does that thing it does
When the day's still a maybe

[Chorus]
Sunrise rhythm, keep it easy, keep it light
Sunrise rhythm, we got time, we got time
Every corner's got a sound, every sound is coming clear
Sunrise rhythm, let the morning find us here

[Bridge]
Papa used to say the morning don't wait for nobody
But look at us, standing here like the clock is ours
If the day wants to start, let it start without us
We'll catch up, we'll catch up
We'll catch up, we'll catch up

[Verse 3]
By noon the shade is gone and the glue on the posters melts
You fan yourself with a receipt, I steal your cap
Somebody's cousin opens a shop and plays the same song twice
We dance two steps, embarrassed, then we dance some more

[Outro]
Danfo horn, danfo horn
Sun high over the bridge now
We got time, we got time
cover_prompt: afrobeats sunrise, Lagos street market, warm gold light, bright colors and motion, 9:16 vertical
